name: Sails & Trails Camp
description_short: Full-day (9am-4pm) camp on Lake Quassapaug, run in two-week sessions. Children can pick sailing plus nature exploration in Flanders' Whittemore Sanctuary (Sails & Trails), or a sailing-only program in Optimist dinghies (ages 9-12) or 420 dinghies (ages 12-16).
refund_policy_summary: No refunds for camp registrations, except when camp is cancelled because of COVID-related government restrictions. Families registered for the cancelled 2026 Session 4 were offered a transfer or a refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers sail and kayak on Lake Quassapaug. They must be comfortable swimming in a life jacket, and there is a swim test (done in a life jacket). Life jackets (Type III USCG approved, non-inflatable) must be worn at all times on or near the water. QSC provides them, but campers may bring their own.

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, and those dates have already passed (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 are not posted yet.

Session price is shown as $630, the non-member rate when registering before May 31. Other rates: $690 for non-members after May 31, and $480 / $540 for QSC members before / after May 31. Each price covers a two-week session.
Ages conflict: the program description says Sails & Trails 2 is for ages 12-16, but the pricing table says 12-14.
For 2026, Session 4 was cancelled and Family Day moved to Saturday, August 1.
The ZIP code (06762) and city come from the P.O. Box mailing address, not the camp's street address.
The Junior Instructor role (ages 16-18) is a job you apply for, not a camp session. It is left out of the age range.
